response.sql: SELECT AVG(amount) AS avg_large_order_amount FROM `order` WHERE amount > 2802.0;

assumptions.assumption: Every row in the `order` table is a standing order, so no filter on k_symbol or other columns is applied.
"Large" means strictly greater than the cutoff (amount > 2802.0), so an order of exactly 2802.0 is excluded.

alternatives.interpretation: "Large" includes orders exactly at the cutoff (amount >= 2802.0).
